title: 玩家控制受限，仅能进行有限互动
description: 玩家只能控制主角的不自主动作或进行非常有限的互动（如查看物品、喝酒翻页），无法控制主角本身或进行有意义的操作。
evidence: u dotn control the star just his involuntary twitches and foibles
your "interactivity" is limited to pressing Q to look at the clock, E to look at the counter, and G to look at the table.
the only real interactivity is the wine swigs, which only serve as a "turn the page" movement every few minutes
